notes: Balance pass for the S.L.A.I. bodies' and legs' armour, a port adaptation (armour_balance.py). S.L.A.I.'s armour is on its own scale: its bodies start about 1.8 times as strong as Phantom Crash's and its legs about 2.2 times, so with the weapons fitted to Phantom Crash's (weapon_balance.json) a S.L.A.I. robot took about twice the shots to bring down.

Per table, the median armour of Phantom Crash's parts over the median of S.L.A.I.'s at each of levels gives a factor; the factors, blended between the two levels, scale every S.L.A.I. part's armour curve, so each keeps its rank among S.L.A.I.'s while the table as a whole sits among Phantom Crash's. Each part records its factors in slai_balance.
fields names the curves scaled per table. Weight, capacity, price and movement stay as registered. enabled false keeps S.L.A.I.'s own armour.
